content: Deploy the file to your website (hosted on HTTPS), then verify it by clicking the "Test statement" button in the Asset Link tool. If it's configured correctly, a Success message will appear: Success! Host [website] grants app deep linking to [app package]. The final step is to configure the Android app to recognize incoming links. Seeherefor WordPress instructions. To verify that the websites and the native apps are configured correctly, the website needs to host the Site Association files but the apps do not need to be in the app stores. Connect a device to your computer, build and deploy the native apps, then test by tapping on website links. If the native app opens, all steps have been implemented correctly.
